Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia kills 2 and wounds 22, including two children.
Sports court to rule today on Senegal's Africa Cup title appeal.

stories.headline: Nvidia brings back Jensen Huang as CEO
stories.summary: Eleven days after he resigned, Huang returns; Nvidia jumps a third, the Nasdaq rallies 6% and the S&P 500 4%.

stories.headline: Ukraine says its drones sank a Russian warship off Libya
stories.summary: Kyiv says seven naval drones sank the corvette Merkury at Benghazi, carrying the war into the Mediterranean.

stories.headline: COP31 collapses in Antalya over fossil fuels
stories.summary: After nearly 50 hours of overtime, 90+ nations reject a final text that never mentions fossil fuels.

stories.headline: Gas blast kills 6 at Hanoi food shop
stories.summary: An explosion at a crowded food shop in the Vietnamese capital injures 10; police blame cooking gas.

stories.headline: 14 nations back ICJ's Rohingya genocide ruling
stories.summary: The UK, Canada, Australia and 11 others acknowledge the verdict; London sanctions five Myanmar generals.

stories.headline: Trump to meet NATO chief Rutte on Wednesday
stories.summary: The Florida talks follow Trump's meetings with Putin and Xi last week, with Ukraine peace on the agenda.
